title: Jan-Mar 2026: Schemes, Reports, Indices, Culture, Sports & Awards

questions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding the World Economic Forum's Global Risks Report 2026:
1. Geoeconomic confrontation was ranked as the top short-term global risk.
2. State-based armed conflict was ranked above geoeconomic confrontation in the short term.
3. Adverse outcomes of AI entered the top ten risks.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.e: The report placed geoeconomic confrontation first, ahead of state-based armed conflict, so statement 2 reverses the order. It also brought adverse outcomes of AI into the top ten. The WEF compiles this report each January from a survey of experts and leaders, so rankings reflect perceived, not measured, risk.
questions.s: Drishti IAS, 17 Jan 2026
questions.h: Trade fights (geoeconomic) now outrank real fights (armed conflict)

questions.q: In the Henley Passport Index 2026, India's passport was ranked at which position, and with visa-free or visa-on-arrival access to how many destinations?
questions.e: India climbed five places from 85th in 2025 to 80th, sharing the rank with Niger and Algeria, with access to 55 destinations. The figure 192 belongs to Singapore, whose passport topped the index. The index ranks passports by the number of destinations holders can enter without a prior visa, using IATA data.
questions.s: Business Today, 14 Jan 2026; Drishti IAS, 15 Jan 2026

questions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding the Beti Bachao Beti Padhao (BBBP) campaign, which completed 11 years in January 2026:
1. The sex ratio at birth rose from about 918 in 2014-15 to 930 in 2023-24.
2. It is now a component of the SAMBAL sub-scheme of Mission Shakti.
3. National Girl Child Day, linked to the campaign's milestone, is observed on 11 October.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.e: National Girl Child Day falls on 24 January, which is why BBBP's milestones are reported around that date; 11 October is the International Day of the Girl Child. BBBP was folded into the SAMBAL sub-scheme of Mission Shakti after the umbrella scheme was restructured.
questions.s: Vajiram & Ravi, 24 Jan 2026; Drishti IAS, 27 Jan 2026
questions.h: 918 to 930; 24 Jan = India's girl, 11 Oct = world's girl

questions.q:
How many of the following initiatives are correctly paired with the ministry or body behind them?
1. SHINE (Standards Help Inform & Nurture Empowered Women) : Bureau of Indian Standards
2. PANKHUDI portal (single-window CSR and partnership platform) : Ministry of Corporate Affairs
3. PANCHAM chatbot : Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
4. Live Events Development Cell : Ministry of Culture
questions.e: Only pair 1 is correct: SHINE was launched by BIS at its 79th Foundation Day. PANKHUDI was launched by the Ministry of Women and Child Development, PANCHAM by the Ministry of Panchayati Raj with UNICEF (it merely uses MeitY's BHASHINI for 22 languages), and the Live Events Development Cell was set up by the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting.
questions.s: Vajiram & Ravi, 7-28 Jan 2026; ETV Bharat, 8 Jan 2026

questions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding the Padma Awards 2026, announced on 25 January 2026:
1. The list comprises 131 awardees.
2. It includes 13 Padma Bhushan awardees.
3. The Padma Awards were instituted in 1954.
4. Recipients are entitled to use the award as a title before or after their names.
How many of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The 2026 list has 5 Padma Vibhushan, 13 Padma Bhushan and 113 Padma Shri awards, 131 in all, and the awards date from 1954. Statement 4 is wrong: Article 18(1) bars the State from conferring titles, and in Balaji Raghavan (1996) the Supreme Court held that Bharat Ratna and Padma awards are not titles and must not be used as prefix or suffix.
questions.s: The News Minute / Gulf News, 25 Jan 2026; Drishti IAS, 27 Jan 2026

questions.q: Group Captain Shubhanshu Shukla, pilot of the Axiom-4 mission to the International Space Station, received the Ashoka Chakra in the Republic Day 2026 gallantry awards. Which one of the following arranges the gallantry awards in that list in descending order of precedence?
o: Ashoka Chakra, Shaurya Chakra, Kirti Chakra, Sena Medal (gallantry)
Kirti Chakra, Ashoka Chakra, Shaurya Chakra, Sena Medal (gallantry)
Ashoka Chakra, Kirti Chakra, Sena Medal (gallantry), Shaurya Chakra
Ashoka Chakra, Kirti Chakra, Shaurya Chakra, Sena Medal (gallantry)
questions.e: The Ashoka Chakra is the highest peacetime gallantry award, followed by the Kirti Chakra, the Shaurya Chakra and then the Sena Medal (gallantry). The 2026 list of 70 awards had 1 Ashoka Chakra, 3 Kirti Chakras, 13 Shaurya Chakras and 44 Sena Medals (gallantry), so each rung of the ladder was represented.
questions.s: Business Today, 25 Jan 2026; Vision IAS, 27 Jan 2026

questions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding the Somnath temple, in the news in January 2026:
1. Somnath Swabhiman Parv (1026-2026) marks 1,000 years since Mahmud of Ghazni's first attack on the temple.
2. Somnath, at Prabhas Patan in Gujarat, is regarded as the first of the 12 Jyotirlingas.
3. The Bhadrakali inscription of 1169 CE records that the Paramara king Bhoja first built the temple in stone.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.e: The Bhadrakali inscription, on the wall of the Bhadrakali Temple at Prabhas Patan, credits Bhimdev of the Solanki dynasty of Anhilwad Patan with building the temple in stone, not the Paramara Bhoja. Statements 1 and 2 are correct; the temple was later rebuilt after Independence, with the Pran-Pratistha performed in 1951.
questions.s: Drishti IAS, 6 Jan 2026; Vajiram & Ravi, 13 Jan 2026

questions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding the Sammakka-Saralamma (Medaram) Jatara, which began on 28 January 2026:
1. It is an annual festival of the Gond community in Telangana.
2. It began at Medaram in Mulugu district.
3. Devotees offer bangaram (jaggery) equal to their body weight.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.e: Statement 1 is wrong on two counts: the Jatara is a biennial three-day festival of the Koya tribe, not an annual Gond festival. It is held at Medaram in the Eturnagaram Wildlife Sanctuary, Mulugu district, and bangaram offerings are its signature ritual. It was declared a State Festival in 1996.
questions.s: Drishti IAS, 21 Jan 2026; Vajiram & Ravi, 18 Jan 2026
questions.h: Koya, every 2 years, jaggery = body weight

questions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding the Corruption Perceptions Index (CPI) 2025:
1. It is published by Transparency International.
2. India ranked 91st among 182 countries with a score of 39 out of 100.
3. A higher CPI score indicates a higher level of perceived public-sector corruption.
4. Singapore ranked first in the index.
How many of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: Statements 1 and 2 are correct; India improved from 96th in 2024. CPI scores run from 0 (highly corrupt) to 100 (very clean), so a higher score means less perceived corruption. Denmark, not Singapore, ranked first with 89, its eighth consecutive time at the top.
questions.s: Drishti IAS, 10 Feb 2026; Newsgram, 11 Feb 2026

questions.q:
Consider the following statements:
1. The World Day of Social Justice, observed on 20 February, was first observed in 2007.
2. UNESCO declared 21 February as International Mother Language Day in 1999.
3. International Mother Language Day commemorates the 1952 Bengali Language Movement in Bangladesh.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.e: The UN General Assembly proclaimed the World Day of Social Justice in 2007, but it was first observed only in 2009, so statement 1 is wrong. International Mother Language Day was declared by UNESCO in 1999 and has been observed since 2000, with 2026 under the theme 'Youth Voices on Multilingual Education'.
questions.s: Drishti IAS, 20 and 24 Feb 2026; Vajiram & Ravi, 24 Feb 2026
questions.h: Social Justice: proclaimed 2007, first held 2009. Mother tongue: declared 1999, first held 2000

questions.q: The India AI Impact Summit 2026, held in New Delhi in February 2026, earned India a Guinness World Record for which one of the following?
o: The most pledges to an AI-responsibility campaign within 24 hours
The largest AI literacy lesson conducted simultaneously
The most AI-generated artworks created within 24 hours
The largest gathering of AI start-ups at a single venue
questions.e: India recorded 250,946 validated pledges, over 2.5 lakh, to an AI-responsibility campaign within 24 hours. The record is for citizen participation in responsible-AI commitments, not for AI output or the size of an industry gathering, which are the plausible-sounding alternatives.
questions.s: Drishti IAS, 20 Feb 2026

questions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding the National Commission for Scheduled Tribes (NCST), which celebrated its 23rd Foundation Day in February 2026:
1. It is a constitutional body under Article 338A, inserted by the Constitution (89th Amendment) Act, 2003.
2. It was created by separating the earlier joint National Commission for Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes.
3. Its Chairperson holds the rank of Minister of State in the Union Government.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.e: The 89th Amendment split the joint SC/ST commission, and the separate NCST began on 19 February 2004 under Article 338A. Its Chairperson holds Union Cabinet Minister rank, while the Vice-Chairperson has MoS rank, so statement 3 is wrong. Article 338 now covers only the SC commission.
questions.s: Vajiram & Ravi, 20 Feb 2026

questions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding the Milano Cortina 2026 Winter Olympics, which ended on 22 February 2026:
1. Norway topped the medal table with 18 gold medals.
2. The Netherlands finished second with 12 gold medals.
3. India did not win any medal at the Games.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.e: Norway led with 18 golds, followed by the United States with 12 and the Netherlands with 10, so statement 2 is wrong. India's two-member contingent, including alpine skier Arif Khan who was 39th in the men's slalom, won no medal; India has never won a Winter Olympic medal.
questions.s: Outlook India, 22 Feb 2026; Channels TV, 22 Feb 2026

questions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding the 68th Grammy Awards, held on 1 February 2026:
1. Bad Bunny's Album of the Year was the first win in that category for a primarily Spanish-language album.
2. Olivia Dean won Record of the Year.
3. Trevor Noah hosted the ceremony for the sixth and final time.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.e: Record of the Year went to Kendrick Lamar, who won five awards in all; Olivia Dean won Best New Artist, so statement 2 swaps the winners. Statements 1 and 3 are correct, and the Spanish-language milestone was the headline of the night.
questions.s: Mocksutra Feb 2026 digest, 1 Feb 2026

questions.q: Which one of the following correctly describes the final of the Women's Premier League (WPL) 2026, played on 5 February 2026?
o: Mumbai Indians beat Royal Challengers Bengaluru by six wickets at Vadodara to win their third title
Royal Challengers Bengaluru beat Delhi Capitals by six wickets at Mumbai to win their first title
Delhi Capitals beat Royal Challengers Bengaluru at Vadodara, chasing 204, to win their first title
Royal Challengers Bengaluru beat Delhi Capitals by six wickets at Vadodara, chasing 204, for their second title
questions.e: RCB chased down 204 at Vadodara with Smriti Mandhana scoring 87, winning by six wickets. It was RCB's second WPL title after their first in 2024, and Delhi Capitals were the beaten finalists, so the options naming a first title or a different winner fail.
questions.s: Mocksutra Feb 2026 digest, 5 Feb 2026

questions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding the extension of the Jal Jeevan Mission (JJM) approved by the Union Cabinet on 10 March 2026:
1. The mission was extended up to December 2028.
2. The total outlay is Rs 8.69 lakh crore.
3. The restructured mission introduces the 'Sujalam Bharat' digital framework with a unique Sujal Gaon ID for each village.
4. The Centre-State funding ratio is 50:50 for Himalayan and North-Eastern States.
How many of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: Statements 1 to 3 are correct; the mission now shifts from building infrastructure to delivering service. Statement 4 is wrong: the 50:50 sharing applies to other States, while Himalayan and North-Eastern States get the more generous 90:10 ratio. JJM was launched on 15 August 2019 to give tap connections to rural households.
questions.s: PM India / PRS India, 10 Mar 2026; Drishti IAS, 11 Mar 2026

questions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding the Fiscal Health Index (FHI) 2026:
1. It is released by the Finance Commission of India.
2. Arunachal Pradesh topped the 10 North-Eastern and Himalayan States.
3. Odisha, Goa and Jharkhand were classified as 'Achievers' among the 18 major States.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.e: The second edition of the FHI was released by NITI Aayog, not the Finance Commission, so statement 1 is wrong. West Bengal, Kerala, Andhra Pradesh and Punjab fell in the 'Aspirational' category among major States. The index rests on five pillars, including quality of expenditure, fiscal prudence and debt sustainability.
questions.s: Vajiram & Ravi, 13 Mar 2026; Drishti IAS, 14 Mar 2026

questions.q: Which one of the following is correct regarding the World Happiness Report 2026, released on 20 March 2026?
o: India ranked 118th, down from 116th, with Finland first for the ninth consecutive year
India ranked 116th, up from 118th, with Denmark first for the ninth consecutive year
India ranked 126th, up from 133rd, with Finland first for the ninth consecutive year
India ranked 116th, up from 118th, with Finland first for the ninth consecutive year
questions.e: India moved up two places from 118th to 116th, and Finland topped the list for the ninth year running. The report is produced by Oxford's Wellbeing Research Centre with Gallup and the UN Sustainable Development Solutions Network, and is released on the International Day of Happiness (20 March).
questions.s: Daily Excelsior, 20 Mar 2026; Drishti IAS, 20 Mar 2026

questions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding BharatNet:
1. The government has said it has extended connectivity to more than 2.15 lakh Gram Panchayats.
2. It is funded by the Universal Service Obligation Fund, which continues under the same name.
3. It is a project of the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.e: The Universal Service Obligation Fund has been replaced by the Digital Bharat Nidhi, which now funds BharatNet, so statement 2 is wrong. BharatNet is a telecom-infrastructure project under the Department of Telecommunications (Ministry of Communications), not MeitY, so statement 3 is also wrong.
questions.s: Vajiram & Ravi, 9 Mar 2026; Drishti IAS, 10 Mar 2026

questions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding the Mahad Satyagraha, whose centenary year began on 20 March 2026:
1. Dr B.R. Ambedkar led the 1927 march to the Chavdar Tank at Mahad.
2. It was launched to secure Dalit entry into the Kalaram Temple at Nashik.
3. 20 March is observed as Social Empowerment Day.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.e: Mahad was a struggle for the right to draw water from a public tank, not for temple entry; the Kalaram Temple entry movement at Nashik came in 1930. The Chavdar Tank is at Mahad in Raigad, Maharashtra, and 20 March is observed as Social Empowerment Day in memory of the 1927 march.
questions.s: Drishti IAS, 20 Mar 2026

questions.q:
Match the categories of the 98th Academy Awards (15 March 2026) with their winners:
Category:
A. Best Picture
B. Best Actor
C. Best Actress
D. Best International Feature
Winner:
1. Jessie Buckley
2. Sentimental Value
3. One Battle After Another
4. Michael B. Jordan
questions.e: One Battle After Another won Best Picture (with Paul Thomas Anderson as Best Director), Michael B. Jordan won Best Actor for Sinners, Jessie Buckley won Best Actress for Hamnet, and Sentimental Value won Best International Feature. Remember that the film wins and the performer wins are different lists, which is where the swapped options trap.
questions.s: Variety, 15 Mar 2026; Storyboard18, 15 Mar 2026

questions.q: Which one of the following is correct regarding the final of the ICC Men's T20 World Cup 2026?
o: India beat New Zealand by 96 runs at Colombo, with Sri Lanka as co-host
India beat England by 96 runs at Kolkata, becoming the first team with three titles
New Zealand beat India in the final at Ahmedabad on 8 March 2026
India beat New Zealand by 96 runs at Ahmedabad, becoming the first team to win three T20 World Cup titles and the first to win it at home
questions.e: India beat New Zealand by 96 runs on 8 March 2026 at the Narendra Modi Stadium, Ahmedabad, scoring 255/5 against 159 all out. India's earlier titles were in 2007 and 2024, so this was a record third, and the first on home soil. The tournament was co-hosted with Sri Lanka, but the final was in Ahmedabad.
questions.s: Drishti IAS, 9 Mar 2026

questions.q:
Consider the following statements:
Statement-I: Lakshya Sen finished as the runner-up in the men's singles at the All England Open 2026.
Statement-II: The title was won by Lin Chun-yi of China, who beat him in straight games in the final.
Which one of the following is correct in respect of the above statements?
o: Both Statement-I and Statement-II are correct and Statement-II explains Statement-I
Both Statement-I and Statement-II are correct and Statement-II does not explain Statement-I
Statement-I is correct but Statement-II is incorrect
Statement-I is incorrect but Statement-II is correct
questions.e: Lin Chun-yi won the final in Birmingham on 8 March 2026 by 21-15, 22-20, so Sen was indeed the runner-up. But Lin represents Chinese Taipei, not China, so Statement-II is incorrect. Wang Zhiyi won the women's singles.
questions.s: All India Radio, 8 Mar 2026

questions.q:
How many of the following pairs are correctly matched?
1. 60th Jnanpith Award (for 2025) : R. Vairamuthu
2. Sahitya Akademi Award 2025 for the English novel 'Crimson Spring' : Navtej Sarna
3. Sahitya Akademi Award 2025 for the Hindi memoir 'Jeete Jee Allahabad' : Navtej Sarna
questions.e: Pairs 1 and 2 are correct. 'Jeete Jee Allahabad' won for Mamta Kalia, while Sarna won for 'Crimson Spring'. Vairamuthu, announced on 14 March 2026, is the third Tamil writer to win the Jnanpith after P.V. Akilan (1975) and D. Jayakanthan (2002), and the first Tamil poet; the Sahitya Akademi awards for 2025 covered 24 languages.
questions.s: IANS, 14 Mar 2026; Drishti IAS, 17-18 Mar 2026; All India Radio, 16 Mar 2026

questions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding the inaugural Khelo India Tribal Games, which began on 25 March 2026:
1. It is India's first national multi-sport event exclusively for tribal athletes.
2. Chhattisgarh, with venues at Raipur, Jagdalpur and Surguja, is the first State to host it.
3. Its mascot is Pearl, a dolphin.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.e: The mascot of the Tribal Games is 'Morveer'; Pearl the dolphin was the mascot of the second Khelo India Beach Games at Diu in January 2026. The Games feature seven medal sports, including athletics, archery and wrestling, plus indigenous sports such as kabaddi and mallakhamb.
questions.s: Vajiram & Ravi, 8 Mar 2026; Drishti IAS, 1 Apr 2026
